t: Grinding the Lenses: Forging a Self-Sufficient AI-Ready Library
s: This article advocates for rigorous code refactoring and a well-defined, reproducible development environment (Nix, Python, HTMX) to achieve a deeper, more effective partnership with AI coding assistants, counteracting the 'tyranny of the commons' and reclaiming 'oneness' with tools.
sub: AI code assistance limitations and context window challenges
Achieving 'oneness' with development tools through skill internalization
Leveraging Nix for reproducible, AI-friendly development environments
The role of HTMX in simplifying web presentation layers
